sample_unit: interview participants (13 pregnant women, 8 healthcare professionals)
unlisted_practices: Provide personalised risk information only when preventative interventions are available
Present single-condition risk outputs rather than composite risk outputs
Visually depict personalised risk scores with clear patient-centred management plans

screen.reason: Qualitative study exploring patient and clinician perspectives on the acceptability and implementation considerations of a cardiometabolic risk prediction tool in early pregnancy.
